recording.note: Commons applies PD-EU-audio and attributes Argerich’s DG recording to 1962. The dossier preserves the competing 1960 recital session and 1961 original-issue attribution; every candidate precedes 1963. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
